description: Backend heartbeat (ops 4397): every 15min drains Claude's A2A inbox and SELF-EXECUTES capability-allowlisted mechanical ops (restart_engine, rebind_schedule, probe_feed) requested by Perplexity/audit-loop, posting results back on the bus. Novel/code/ambiguous requests escalate to Claude (data/backend-agent/escalations.json). The autonomous backend half — closes the gap where Claude only ran on Khalid's messages.
